name: What are the common types of windows available for home installation?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of windows available for home installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common window types include double-hung, casement, sliding, picture, and bay or bow windows. Double-hung windows are popular for their classic look and ventilation options. Casement windows offer excellent energy efficiency and unobstructed views when open. Sliding windows operate horizontally and are a good choice for wider openings. Picture windows are stationary and designed to maximize natural light and views. Bay and bow windows extend outward, creating additional space and a distinctive aesthetic for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common window types are double-hung, casement, sliding, picture, and bay/bow windows, each offering distinct features for ventilation, light, and aesthetics.
